| [QUESTION-120](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-120.md) v5 | Beyond distances and sparse recovery, whose thresholds share a sufficiency proof and not a necessity proof, when the record meets a random linear map that keeps what a later stage needs, in random features for kernels, the superposition toy model's bound and phase changes, and the expand-and-threshold codes of sparse distributed memory and the fly, is it one concentration-of-measure fact applied to different families, and does each threshold count the same thing? | Filed when a survey of the record found random projections in three places and the Johnson–Lindenstrauss lemma in none.
